description: A People Operations Partner must decide whether Casey should continue serving as the direct client liaison after repeated friction with Morgan and must finalize a workable handoff, meeting, and repair structure.

shared_context.S1: Casey currently serves as the direct client liaison for the Northstar account, while Morgan is the account lead.
shared_context.S2: Casey and Morgan have had tense interactions during several recent handoffs.
shared_context.S3: Elena has authority to set a temporary assignment and the working process for the account.
shared_context.S4: The account team holds a weekly coordination meeting to review handoffs and client-contact responsibilities.

PF1.text: Ravi personally observed three heated handoff incidents between Casey and Morgan in the past month, and Morgan has asked not to meet one-to-one with Casey until a facilitated repair occurs; Ravi's incident notes have not yet been submitted to Elena.

PF2.text: Casey has a fixed caregiving pickup at 15:45 and can commit to one recurring coordination meeting from 15:00 to 15:30, but cannot reliably attend a later meeting or more than two live coordination meetings per week; Casey has not raised this because the revised arrangement has not yet been discussed.

acceptance_conditions: Casey must either temporarily move to internal handoff coordination or remain client liaison only with coordination routed through a structured neutral process.
Casey and Morgan must use a neutral structured handoff process, such as a shared channel or written briefs with a recurring coordination meeting, rather than direct ad hoc one-to-one handoffs.
Casey must have no more than two live coordination meetings per week.
The recurring coordination meeting must run from 15:00 to 15:30.
A facilitated repair between Casey and Morgan must be committed to before direct one-to-one work resumes.

content_checks.C5: any(c['type'] in ['facilitated_repair', 'facilitated_process'] and c['target'] == 'Casey and Morgan' for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in revealed and 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids

decisive_facts.why: The three observed incidents and Morgan's no-one-to-one condition change the assignment to either internal handoff coordination or a structured neutral liaison process, require the neutral handoff mode, and require a facilitated repair.
Casey's fixed 15:45 pickup changes the plan to exactly two live coordination meetings per week and fixes the recurring meeting at exactly 15:00-15:30.
